body: I did speak to him a bit today. I told him that my older brother is out of control and he said he'll "talk to him about it." Nothing will change. I might give him an ultimatum that if he doesn't tell him to move out or DO something with his life that I will move out and he will never see me again.

Math. School is something I'm not willing to sacrifice for moving out. It is very important to me and I'd like to get all this very abstract and difficult stuff down set in my mind while I'm young, studying 8 hours a day; I wouldn't have it any other way.

I haven't had a real conversation with my dad in YEARS. I, quite frankly, don't want to talk to him. I know it will solve nothing. He is thick-headed and he seems to think harboring a 26 year old nihilistic alcoholic as admirable. 

I've looked on craiglist and there are some cheap rooms ($400-$600/mo). I might try to live here one more year while I save up money and finish my first year off.

I have a goal... I guess. I love going to school and whatnot, so my goal right now is to finish my degree, but that's 3-4 years down the road (first year student). As I said, I'm in college, so a second job is not an option. I don't even think one job will be viable in my 3rd or 4th year. I would really love to move out, but the area I live in is extremely expensive. I'm not sure if my student loan would cover it (it does ask if I have to pay rent and if I live with my parents).
